title: ISO 1083:2018 — Spheroidal graphite cast irons — Classification
locator: Defines grades and requirements for spheroidal graphite cast irons; classification is based on mechanical properties measured on machined test pieces prepared from cast samples; reviewed and confirmed in 2023.
notes: 不能把球墨铸铁标准牌号与灰铸铁牌号或具体机床部件的选材决策混为一谈；样品类型和机械性能确认条件必须按标准/采购文件落实。标准全文未下载/归档。
